caption: The drawing features a collection of objects assembled together in the center against a plain, light beige background. The objects include a dark brown rectangular dustpan or tray positioned on the left, held in place by a metallic clamp beneath it. Attached to the clamp, there is a wooden block to which a pair of scissors with metallic blades and black handles is affixed. A paintbrush with bristles and a wooden handle is also inserted into the wooden block. Curved metallic tongs or forceps are positioned above the wooden block, with their arms bent and extending upward and outward. The composition is centered with ample empty space surrounding the cluster of objects. In the lower right quadrant, the artist's name, "WAYNE WHITE," is typed in small, uppercase letters. The color palette includes muted browns, metallic grays, and natural wood tones, with minimal shadowing and no background elements.
title: Cherry Pitter
